submission.justification: Algorithm-L3 at 35 GeV gives the highest efficiency of the three candidates (92.5%). The runner-up, L1, reaches 84.1%, a margin of 8.4 points. L3's efficiency curve peaks at 35 GeV and falls off on both sides. The 35 GeV threshold lies within 20-60 GeV, and the documents show no deployability problems. Caveat: the latency budget is not documented, so L3's fit within it is unverified. Also, the recorded results give no direct confirmation that the 8 kHz rate is met at 35 GeV.

requirements.requirement: Highest possible signal efficiency at allocated rate (8 kHz)
requirements.evidence: L3 at 35 GeV has the best efficiency, 92.531%, versus 84.102% for L1 and 74.275% for L2. The recorded results contain no rate measurement at the 8 kHz allocation, so whether 35 GeV meets it is unconfirmed.
